title: DOW-UAP-D080, Narrative Statement 2, Western United States Event, 2023
what_is_it: First-hand witness narrative memorandum documenting a federal law enforcement agent's observation of unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) in the western United States.
core_summary: Witness 2, a U.S. federal law enforcement special agent, reported observing bright orb-like lights that expelled smaller red lights over two days in October 2023 while surveying an area for drone activity in the western United States. The bright orb-like lights appeared on the northern/northeastern horizon, expelled three or four red lights that moved in coordinated horizontal formations, and the red lights hovered above the southern horizon for several hours. Multiple teams positioned throughout the area confirmed observing the same objects.
interpretation_warnings: This is a single-witness narrative (Witness 2) though corroboration from other teams is claimed but not independently documented here.
The source text is an OCR extraction from an image file (JPG), resulting in numerous typographical errors that may affect accuracy of specific details.
The document is truncated — it ends mid-sentence at 'Al' on page 1, indicating additional content exists but was not captured.
No sensor data, photographs, or instrument readings accompany this narrative — it is purely observational testimony.
The witness was surveying for drone activity, which may have primed expectations for aerial observations.
Distance, altitude, and size of the objects are not estimated in absolute terms, only relative angles and proportions.

public_headline: Federal Agent Reports Bright Orbs Expelling Red Lights Over Western US
public_tldr: This unclassified Department of War document is a first-hand witness statement from a U.S. federal law enforcement agent who observed bright orb-like lights expelling smaller red lights over two evenings in October 2023. The agent was originally surveying for drone activity in a valley in the western United States when the sighting occurred, and multiple teams in the area confirmed seeing the same objects.
public_narrative:
This document, designated DOW-UAP-D080, is a narrative statement provided to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) by a federal law enforcement special agent identified only as "Witness 2." The statement describes events the witness observed in October 2023 while on assignment in a valley in the western United States, where the agent and their partner had been tasked with surveying for individuals launching drones.

At approximately 7:00 PM on a clear evening, the witness observed a bright circular orb-like light positioned roughly 35 to 45 degrees above the northern/northeastern horizon. The light had a smaller red orb-like light within it and emitted what the witness described as a bright "aural" glow with a slight halo effect — distinct from an artificial neon light. Over the next 30 minutes, the orb expelled groups of three or four smaller red lights approximately five times. Each group of red lights was roughly one-fifteenth the size of the main orb and accelerated instantly into coordinated horizontal formations.

After the expulsion phase ended around 7:30 PM, the red lights hovered above the southern horizon in an aligned, equally spaced formation until approximately 11:00 PM — a span of about three and a half hours. The red lights occasionally dipped below the horizon before rising back up. Other law enforcement teams positioned throughout the area independently confirmed observing the same objects.

The document is marked UNCLASSIFIED and dated 2 June 2026. It contains no photographs, sensor data, or instrument readings — it is purely observational testimony. Notably, the document appears to be truncated, ending mid-sentence, which means additional details from the witness may exist but were not captured in this release.
public_caveats: This is a single witness's account. While the statement claims other teams confirmed the sighting, their independent statements are not included in this document.
